declared_changes_from_v1: Primary family restructured: CyberGym now supplies BOTH the training pool and the isolated target, split by a disjoint-identity standard. The 4-6 pilot environments are constructed within the CyberGym training pool, so training distribution E and target D are same-domain and the contrast is interpretable.

SEC-Bench Pro (V8+SpiderMonkey, ~207 verified cases) is formally rejected as the isolated target because it fails the target-capacity gate (207 < 246). It is retained only as an optional external transfer target.

CTF-style families (CTF-Dojo, Random-Crypto, InterCode-CTF) are demoted to OPTIONAL cross-domain challenger environments. They are not the primary contrast and their license/containment audit is deferred with them.

Starting policy pinned to the agentic warm start (nvidia/Nemotron-Terminal-8B) at a SINGLE 8B scale for the pilot. The multi-scale ladder needed for the fit-through-8B / predict-larger extrapolation is deferred to the powered study as a separately budgeted project.

Reliability gate thresholds are UNCHANGED. An a-priori operating-characteristic simulation (reliability_oc_sim.py / reliability_oc.json), frozen before any cyber rollout and NOT assuming the starting policy's success rate, sets the rollout budget and an explicit UNMEASURABLE abstention verdict.
Pilot scientific claim narrowed and stated explicitly (see narrowed_claim).
Capacity and disjointness gates are checked at project / patch-equivalence-class granularity, not raw task count.
authorization_blockers: record the exact local warm-start artifact digest and verify it matches the agentic warm start
complete the disjoint-identity standard audit and report distinct-project and distinct-patch-class counts
verify the target-capacity gate holds at project granularity (>= 246 target tasks from disjoint projects, training pool still able to yield 4-6 distinct environments)
complete static containment review and fixture oracle/no-op/reset checks on the frozen 48-task subset

disjointness_standard.description: Training pool and isolated target must be disjoint across ALL of the following, not merely exact task or CVE.

target_memorization_temporal_audit.rule: audit the target partition for CVEs disclosed before the Nemotron-8B knowledge cutoff; such tasks may leak through the base model and contaminate the target independent of training

disjointness_standard.shared_instrument_not_a_confound: shared verifier mechanism and submission service are the measurement instrument and do not require disjointness

target_capacity_gate.note: raw CyberGym task count (1507) is NOT the capacity measure; the gate is evaluated after the disjointness standard is applied

subset_selection.generator_modification_required: extend to emit the >=246-task disjoint target partition alongside the 48-task probe subset from the SAME frozen ordering

view_reliability.abstention_rule: if the frozen OC simulation shows the observed success regime below the reliably-measurable floor, increase rollouts or return UNMEASURABLE; never lower the thresholds

narrowed_claim.statement: The pilot tests which CONTROL-VARIED environment (constructed within the CyberGym training pool) best improves the isolated CyberGym target at a fixed generated-token budget. It does NOT claim to rank whole benchmark families.

construction_control_gate.rule: construction controls (prerequisite exposure, starting state, feedback granularity, task mixture) must not inject target-relevant information or weaken the frozen target evaluation
construction_control_gate.fallback_if_controls_not_distinct: define environments by disjoint source strata or difficulty bands

feasibility_budget.phase_b_containment_build_checkpoint: stop and report if the containment build overruns the engineering/elapsed/storage budget rather than silently consuming pilot budget
